title: Disease vs health-record
detail: Add condition and Resolve in the event deck and the Health record built in Inspection both cover recording and closing a condition. They differ: the deck has one Conditions field with triage inline (Monitor preset), Recover and Strike verbs with silent prints, and no care instructions; the Health record has care levels (No action needed, Monitor, Treat in place, Move to hospital pen) as the editable state, per-pig change preview, and Recovered or Entered in error that keep the case in history. Both are in-design and cannot both be the feature.
options: The Health record is the one design; the deck's Add and Resolve become its history only
The deck is the design and the Health record is rebuilt to it
Merge: the deck's verdict page and silent prints with the Health record's care levels
recommendation: Decide with the vet which of the two models of recovery (closed line vanishes vs kept in history) is right, then keep one.

title: Triage level vs care level
detail: The deck's Triage is a standalone mark with three levels (Hospital pen, Treat in place, Monitor), no case required, no 'healthy' level, and the marked set is drained by filtering. The Health record (and the Inspection walk) has care on a condition with four levels, including No action needed, and the PRD says hospital pen is a care choice only with no move made. Same words, two models: a mark on the pig versus a state of a condition.
options: Keep the deck's pig-level mark and drop care from the condition
Keep care on the condition and drop the standalone mark
Keep both, with the mark as a shortcut that writes the care level
recommendation: One concept with one set of level names; confirm whether a pig can be flagged before any condition is named.

title: The shared death form
detail: The Piglet processing ruling asks for one shared death picker. Today there are four: the deck's Report death (cause from the condition catalogue, roster and conveyor for tagged pigs, 'Cause unknown' as an option), the deck's group count sheet, Farrowing's sow-death entry, and Piglet processing's 'Record death' (count by cause steppers, no tagged piglets, an open issue on that screen). Cause lists, photo handling and tagged-versus-count behaviour differ.
options: One death form for pigs and groups across Inspection, Farrowing and Piglet processing, built from the deck
Keep Piglet processing's count-by-cause for litters and use the deck for the rest
Leave each context its own form
recommendation: One form; the deck's count sheet is already the litter flow generalised.

title: Treat vs the Health record's treatment
detail: The deck's Treatment page has six fields with one dose per pig, a union of targets with fractions and an absent target field when nothing is open. The Health record's 'Record treatment' has a shared dose with a per-pig override, optional brand, linked condition and note, and one record per included pig. Dose logic and required fields differ.
options: Merge: one dose with an override and the deck's target fractions
recommendation: Settle together with the disease decision; treatment should not be designed twice.

title: Measures: one pig at a time vs one list
detail: The deck records weight, backfat and temperature one pig at a time on a conveyor (per-confirm commit, skip, running list as receipt). The Pig profile's 'Record weight, temperature or backfat' sheet is a single scrolling list with one field per pig and one Save for the selection. The deck's own reason (a reading belongs to one animal, no draft) conflicts with the list's batch Save and 'blocks the whole save on one invalid row'.
options: Conveyor everywhere, as in the deck
List form everywhere, as in the Pig profile
Conveyor for the walk, list for the pig record
recommendation: Conveyor, as the Synthesis laws state per-confirm commit; retire the list.
